lines.text: Who is Alice Huang, and why did her NVIDIA link draw scrutiny?
NVIDIA's top AI chips are so powerful, America restricts their export to China.
She was an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore cloud company.
Bloomberg estimates its network imported about four point six billion dollars of NVIDIA hardware.
Investigators are probing possible diversion to China. No charges have been filed.
But Chinese firms, reportedly including Alibaba, could rent that computing power from data centers abroad.
The chips stay. The computing power travels.
The New York Times reports officials suspect intelligence ties, and a relationship with Jensen Huang, who later resigned. China and Megaspeed reject the claims.
You don't need to own a chip to use it.

corrections_applied: Alice = 'an executive at Megaspeed' (not CEO/founder) per C02
allegations attributed to NYT; denials included per C11
renting framed as legal at the time; not presented as wrongdoing per C08
